newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cosco places 4.7 bln yen ship order.
newsitem.headline: Cosco places 4.7 bln yen ship order.

text.p: Shipping company Cosco (Singapore) Pte Ltd said on Tuesday it had placed a 4.7 billion yen order for two bulk container ships through Japan's Mitsubishi Corp.
Delivery from shipbuilder Sanoyas Hishino Meisho Corp of Japan is scheduled for the second half of 1998.
In an announcement to the Singapore stock exchange, Cosco said the deal for the two deisel-powered 46,500 deadweight tonnes (dwt) vessels was part of a planned expansion of its fleet.
Financing for the purchase will be from both internal and external resources, said Cosco.
Cosco said the acquisition is expected "to have a favourable impact on the net earnings per share, but will have no impact on the net tangible assets per share" for the year ending December 31, 1996.
